# Withheld tribunal reasoning — [2025] UKFTT 1138 (GRC)
# Gold-labelling material; NEVER include in a prompt.

== Conclusion ==
59. For all those reasons, the Tribunal concludes that AWL was not entitled to rely upon regulation 12(5)(a) to withhold the requested Abstraction Licence numbers.

60. We allow the appeal and issue a substituted decision. In addition, we are alive to the possibility of risks if further requests are made to the EA, and we direct AWL to provide the EA with a copy of this Decision.
